mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate meclizine's anticholinergic effects and increase orthostatic hypotension risk; additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects may occur.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, assess for dizziness/syncope, counsel on fall prevention, and consider alternative antiemetics if significant orthostatic hypotension develops.
